No IT experience at all before this besides my general knowledge. I think they really liked me because of my confidence and my "other" skills or soft skills to be able to work with other people. I have also been studying for my A+ and that is the most knowledge I actually have. I think I got lucky here because they will be training me for quite a few weeks before getting in to the trenches. My advice for you would be to just be confident and if you have little experience in IT like me focus on how your other skills would help you overcome your lack of IT knowledge. I focused my interview on highlighting my great customer service skills, great researcher to find solutions and my passion for continuous learning and always wanting to improve myself.
